interpretation: The in-memory 4 MiB GPU-routed public seed moved from 59.739 ms to 11.145 ms p50 (-81.3%) and from 67.717 ms to 12.010 ms p95 (-82.3%) on the same host and protocol.
The explicit offsets/state encode contrast is now 15.820 ms against the former 39.047 ms known-ID span-bridge contrast (2.47x lower).
The GPU ID-only route improved from 5.181 ms to 4.113 ms p50; the corrected-CPU engine itself is unchanged (47.454 ms before, 47.209 ms now).
SQLite remains a separately measured durable tier; its increment over the in-memory seed is 34.6 ms on the GPU host and 43.7 ms on the EPYC host.
The optional seed-digest overlap hides about 1.0 ms of the GPU-routed seed (9%) and about 5.0 ms of the CPU-routed store-shape seed on the EPYC host; it stays off by default.
Every observation was checked for exact IDs after its timer; no sample was rejected.
